title: Salon gier — ulica
description: Krótki plan ogólny ulicy po wyjściu z salonu. Chłopcy są już na chodniku; kontynuują krok i zachowują pozycje względem siebie, Dariusz po lewej, Owczar po prawej. Nie wracają do schodów. Dariusz opuszcza już uniesioną dłoń, bez dodawania rekwizytów. Montaż 1,5 s; źródło minimum 3 s.

prompts.image: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Create ONE final live-action film still, 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input 1 is a WORKING BLENDER RENDER, strictly a camera, spatial layout, scale and composition reference, NOT the final visual style. Input 2 is a SMALL PERSPECTIVE/BLOCKING GUIDE of the same camera: its converging lines explain real spatial directions and its primitive figures mark human placement. Do not reproduce the guide, linework, captions, faceted bodies, plastic surfaces or crude geometry. Rebuild the visible scene as a convincing photographed physical place while retaining the prescribed viewpoint, major dimensions, openings, object positions and framing. Improve natural material variation, construction details, contact shadows and realistic light; do not redesign the layout or invent different architecture. No game-engine look, no illustration, no split panels, no watermark. Early-1990s provincial Polish atmosphere, understated cinematic realism and restrained film grain, no modern products. Input 3 is the exact production identity and wardrobe reference: Dariusz is the chubby red-brown wavy-haired boy with rectangular dark glasses on the LEFT of that reference; Owczar is the slim dark-blond boy in the burgundy track jacket on its RIGHT. Both are 13–14, clean-shaven. Preserve their specific faces, hair, age, body shape and clothing. Owczar has TWO cream stripes on each sleeve, ivory T-shirt, loose blue jeans and worn pale canvas trainers. Dariusz has an open grey-blue plaid overshirt, grey/navy striped T-shirt, dark loose jeans and dark worn trainers. Their positions in the final shot are dictated by the shot instructions, not by the identity reference layout. Replace all visible primitive stand-ins with anatomically natural boys, and insert the boys where requested even if the clean render is empty. No adult beard, no extra people. SHOT ACTION AND COMPOSITION: Wide establishing view of the basement arcade entrance and old Polish street. Boys have just reached the pavement near the stairs, small in the frame, moving together toward screen right. Preserve projecting SALON GIER sign. Soft urban overcast daylight, believable worn materials and subtle dirt without theatrical decay. Keep the same natural atmosphere across the street and shop sequence.
prompts.animation: 0.0–1.5s: The two boys continue their existing walking stride along the clear pavement, slightly toward the foreground, maintaining their spacing: Dariusz screen left and Owczar screen right. Dariusz lowers the hand already raised near his chest; Owczar briefly glances toward him while keeping his hands in his pockets. 1.5–3.0s: Continue walking at the same unhurried pace without reversing direction. Camera: locked wide establishing view. Only nearby leaves move faintly. @Image1 fixes the existing boys facial identities only. Preserve architecture, stair opening, daylight and exact SALON GIER lettering. No new props in the raised hand, new pedestrians, vehicles, teleportation or cuts.
